THERE’S ROOM FOR ANOTHER PAN

A little company goes a long way.

Meet local prospectors, swap questions online, or find a club to learn alongside. Explore clubs, associations, Meetup groups, Facebook communities, forums and Reddit.

A growing selection, mainly in the United States, with Australian and worldwide online communities. Google Groups is represented by a clearly marked historical archive.

About these listings

Each entry shows its own source-check date. Facebook links come from the clubs’ own websites; private discussions were not inspected. Group access and membership rules are set by each community. Follow its own site for current events and participation details.

This is a starter directory, rather than complete coverage of every state. Historical archives are labeled separately. Listings identify communities; they do not confer permission to prospect or certify advice posted by members.
